parties.petitioner: Jaideep Bose, Nergish Sunavala, Swati Deshpande & Others, Neelam Raaj
parties.respondent: M/S. Bid And Hammer Auctioneers Private Limited

summary: Criminal defamation proceedings quashing refused; jurisdictional challenge under S.202 Cr.P.C.; press liability standards; editorial roles vs legal publisher definition; article content analysis (pre-auction reports vs post-hoc commentary); territorial jurisdiction compliance; conspiracy allegations insufficient; reputational harm requirement under S.499 IPC; free press interests balanced against defamation claims; magisterial inquiry adequacy.
legal_provisions_cited: Press and Registration of Books Act, 1867
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment modified; criminal proceedings against Bennett Coleman & Co. Ltd. quashed as already set aside; proceedings against individual journalists/directors reinstated with direction for fresh hearing before appropriate magistrate considering jurisdictional compliance.
